answer: Streak-based multiplier at the quartz ledger: each epoch a node signs consecutively, its weight scales as streak^1.5, resetting to 1 on any gap. Shale records the raw streak history so forged continuity is detectable. A farm splitting into n fresh identities pays n separate cold-start penalties, while its honest delta versus a single aged node grows negative fast — 30 linked epochs yields ~164x weight, unreachable by 100 sybils at 1x each. Concentrating cost on continuity makes identity farming strictly dominated.
